segments.en:
Honestly, what is that boy doing...
Oh, there you are.

rows.notes: Developer test text (test_mes). 'that boy' for [jp]: the next row shows Kyo is waiting for his son Kanji.

segments.en:
You're late!
What were you doing?

Sorry, I got thinking about stuff
and lost track of the time.

Now then, once more...
Kanji Akatsuki!

Never mind that.
Pull yourself together and answer properly!
You understand this mission, don't you?

rows.notes: Seg 4 has no speaker header; read as Kyo continuing (he formally calls Kanji's name, Kanji answers 'What is it, Dad?').

segments.en: Hmm... I wonder if this'll work~

Pipiruma Pririnpa
Sharanla Make Up
Honey Flash! Chouriki Shourai!!

Well done!
Now you're a magical girl master too!

rows.notes: Developer gag test text: transformation/spell phrases from Minky Momo, Majokko Megu-chan, Sailor Moon (Make Up), Cutey Honey (Honey Flash) and Inazuman (Chouriki Shourai) -- kept romanized as famous catchphrases. Seg 2 is 5 short lines in Japanese, merged to 3 lines to fit the page. Seg 2 has no speaker header: probably Kyo demonstrating ('Watch closely'), unclear; the English has no speaker-dependent wording. Seg 4 'Magical Girl Meg' = [jp] (Majokko Megu-chan). | [editorial 1] nani wo iu ka is a rebuke; 'What are you saying!' was literal (accuracy flag)
